metadata.description: Equip your agents with skills to interact with ModelScope — model/dataset management, Studio deployment, MCP services, and Skills Center.

plugins.name: ms-hub
plugins.description: Unified ModelScope operations hub. Manage models, datasets, Studios, MCP services, and skills via CLI, SDK, and OpenAPI.

plugins.name: ms-studio-deploy
plugins.description: Deploy local projects to ModelScope Studios. Supports Gradio, Streamlit, Docker, and static sites with full deployment workflow and auto-diagnosis.

plugins.name: ms-mcp-manage
plugins.description: Search, deploy, and configure MCP services for IDEs and agent frameworks.

plugins.name: ms-skill-manage
plugins.description: Search, install, and publish Agent Skills on the ModelScope Skills Center.
